skills.name: bid-analysis
skills.description: Bid-analysis skill for tendering workflows. Given N uploaded files of mixed formats (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned images, pictures, plain text, possibly from different projects), it first losslessly converts each to Markdown preserving structure and content, then identifies whether any file is a public tender document using weighted signals (title, issuing body, tender number, bidder instructions, evaluation method) and reverse signals for bid submissions, contracts, and award notices. When a tender is found, it locates and outputs the technical scoring table as a faithful Markdown table; missing parts are reported honestly, never fabricated. If no tender is found, it outputs only a fixed prompt and makes no speculation.
skills.description_zh: 招投标业务分析技能。面向用户上传的多种格式文件（PDF、Word、Excel、扫描件、图片、文本等，可来自同一或不同项目），先将其完整转换为 Markdown 并保留结构与内容；再加权识别其中是否存在公开招标文件（依据标题、发布主体、招标编号、投标人须知、评标办法等特征，并区分投标文件/合同/中标通知等反向特征）；命中招标文件后定位并以 Markdown 表格完整输出技术评分表，缺失则如实说明、绝不编造；若全部不是招标文件则仅输出固定话术，不做任何推测。
skills.description_en: Bid-analysis skill for tendering workflows. Given N uploaded files of mixed formats (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned images, pictures, plain text, possibly from different projects), it first losslessly converts each to Markdown preserving structure and content, then identifies whether any file is a public tender document using weighted signals (title, issuing body, tender number, bidder instructions, evaluation method) and reverse signals for bid submissions, contracts, and award notices. When a tender is found, it locates and outputs the technical scoring table as a faithful Markdown table; missing parts are reported honestly, never fabricated. If no tender is found, it outputs only a fixed prompt and makes no speculation.
examples_zh: 帮我分析这个文件夹里的招标文件，提取技术评分表
这份 PDF 是公开招标文件吗？是的话请把技术评分表以表格输出
我上传了 5 个文档，帮我判断哪些是招标文件、哪些是投标文件或合同
examples_en: Analyze the tender documents in this folder and extract the technical scoring table

skills.name: bid-doc-review
skills.description: Pre-submission audit for bids. Checks your bid against the tender clause by clause: missing qualification and formal items, starred requirements softened into optional wording, inconsistent figures between technical and commercial volumes, gaps in supporting evidence and deviation tables. Then runs a separate scan of statutory disqualification triggers (bid security, collusion presumption, certificate validity, schedule consistency, altered bill of quantities) that void a bid even when the tender never mentions them. Finally traces contradictions the whole document cannot survive: dates that do not line up, figures that do not add up, personnel certificates that do not match the bidding entity. Reconciles declaration forms against embedded scans and returns a citable issue list you can fix directly.
skills.description_zh: 交标前的全面自查。对照招标文件逐条核：资格审查与形式审查有无漏项、星号条款和必现内容有无含糊带过、技术标商务标数值口径是否一致、证明材料与偏离表是否齐全；独立扫法定废标情形（保证金、串标、资质有效期、工期一致性、清单改动），招标文件没写也照样废；再查前后逻辑硬伤——日期排不排得出来、金额加不加得起来、人员证书与主体对不对得上。扫描件与申报表逐项对账，输出带原文出处、能直接照着改的问题清单与审查报告。
skills.description_en: Pre-submission audit for bids. Then runs a separate scan of statutory disqualification triggers (bid security, collusion presumption, certificate validity, schedule consistency, altered bill of quantities) that void a bid even when the tender never mentions them. end-to-end accept-equivalence verification; three-way merge of parallel A/B edits from a base.

skills.name: first-principles
skills.description: A deep-analysis agent that strips problems down to underlying facts and physical constraints, then rebuilds the answer from scratch. It separates non-negotiable physical laws from breakable human conventions, quantifies the gap between current reality and the theoretically optimal outcome, forces a single highest-leverage priority, and stress-tests the conclusion for wishful thinking and unverified assumptions. Use it for major decisions, strategy choices, bottleneck diagnosis, startup direction, technology trade-offs, and any situation where 'everyone does it this way' is the only justification. Delivers a structured report covering the hard-core constraint, perfect end state, single priority, broken false constraints, ranked assumptions and honest self-check.
skills.description_zh: 把复杂问题还原到底层事实与物理约束，从零重建答案的深度分析助手。通过物理法则过滤器区分不可妥协的铁律与可打破的假约束，用理论完美倒推法量化现实与最优解的差距，再通过强制排序收敛到唯一该做的事，最后用愿望思维检测器检验结论中的乐观假设与自欺。适用于重大决策、战略选择、瓶颈诊断、创业方向判断、技术路线取舍，以及任何"大家都这么做但说不清为什么"的场景。输出结构化分析报告：硬核约束、完美终局、唯一优先级、被打破的假约束、未验证假设清单与诚实自检。
skills.description_en: A deep-analysis agent that strips problems down to underlying facts and physical constraints, then rebuilds the answer from scratch. It separates non-negotiable physical laws from breakable human conventions, quantifies the gap between current reality and the theoretically optimal outcome, forces a single highest-leverage priority, and stress-tests the conclusion for wishful thinking and unverified assumptions. skills.name: floorplan-render
skills.description: Reads a floor plan, detects every room, and batch-generates whole-home renders in a chosen style. A true-scale top-down 2D floor plan is a mandatory companion output (four layers of dimensions, wall thickness, eleven engineering self-checks; nothing ships until FAIL=0). No render is produced before the plan view is confirmed, and every prompt is script-generated from the layout JSON, copied verbatim - never hand-written. Two safety gates since 4.0 (uploaded-image safety review plus pre-generation compliance check). Occupant profiles (elderly / children / pets / home office) become hard render constraints - rounded children's furniture, grab-bar space in senior rooms, storage-first layouts. Consistency is graded honestly - L1 structure guaranteed, L2 item count mostly guaranteed, L3 orientation unreliable, L4 size and wall-coverage ratio not achievable (the plan view governs). Ships 17-point QC with watermark post-processing, buildability verdicts, material lists and listing copy.

skills.name: gbt7714-reference-checker
skills.description: Submit a reference list (pasted text or an uploaded paper) for two jobs. First, format compliance against the Chinese national standard GB/T 7714—2025: completeness and order of bibliographic elements, type and carrier identifiers, punctuation conventions, and consistency between in-text citations and the reference list, covering both the numeric and author-date systems and the newly added types (datasets, preprints, archives, maps), with corrected examples ready to copy. Second, existence verification: entries with a DOI, or English-language entries generally, are checked against live Crossref metadata field by field and labelled verified / likely version mismatch / invalid DOI / likely non-existent; Chinese-language and other records that cannot be queried programmatically are compiled into an actionable manual checklist naming the platform, search string, and fields to confirm. Not for bibliographic retrieval or citation style conversion.

skills.name: literature-report-ppt

A supplied .pptx template is applied: master, layouts, theme fonts and logo inherited, cover, TOC and closing pages cloned then rewritten, setup page removed. Titles are noun phrases, no page numbers, body within 5 lines per slide, detail in speaker notes, three audits before delivery. Works across disciplines including medicine, life sciences, engineering and the humanities. skills.name: local-ocr
skills.description: Offline text recognition based on RapidOCR, supporting PNG/JPG/BMP/TIF/WEBP/PDF with Simplified Chinese, English and digits, all processed locally with no network access and no file uploads. PDFs are handled on two paths: pages with a text layer are extracted directly for speed and accuracy, while scanned pages are rendered at the given DPI before OCR. Works on single files or whole directories, emitting text with bounding boxes and confidence scores. First use requires running setup.py to provision an isolated virtual environment (auto-detects WorkBuddy bundled or system Python, installs from the Tsinghua mirror, about 320MB); after that it works permanently offline.

It does not move or modify files; it makes the knowledge base legible, aligns responsibilities, and produces a cleanup plan.

For end-to-end paper writing, topic selection, outlining, or manuscript review coaching, pair this skill with the "我的论文导师" skill.

skills.description_en: A professional academic paper deduplication and de-AI-ification assistant. It helps lower text similarity, remove AI-generated markers (overused connectives, parallel triplets, hollow praise, templated openings), and make scholarly writing read more natural—meeting the requirements of CNKI, VIP, Turnitin and other plagiarism/AI detectors. Provides diagnosis, rewriting, and verification workflows while strictly preserving academic integrity. For end-to-end paper writing, topic selection, outlining, or manuscript review coaching, pair this skill with the "我的论文导师" skill.

examples_zh: 收到创造性审查意见怎么答复

skills.name: personal-writing-style
skills.description: Remember and reproduce your own writing voice so output stops sounding robotic. Name and add scenes yourself, one General scene as fallback; each keeps nine sections - hard rules, vocabulary, soft habits, deletion tendencies, negative samples, adaptation boundary. Calibration: draft, revise, script-computed diff, extract rules, write back. A feature becomes a hard rule only after two independent appearances with quoted evidence; typos are quarantined, not learned. Character-level retention separates rewording from discarded content; converges after two rounds under 20% change, and a passive 'looks good' is zero signal needing a deviation probe. Round four blind-tests a new topic. Writing: infer scene, confirm in one line, write, pass five self-checks. Degrades honestly when uncalibrated; research reports and social copy stay with their own skills - this one only does the final voice pass.
skills.description_zh: 记住并复刻你本人的写作与说话风格，让 AI 产出去掉机器味。① 场景自定义：场景由你自己命名和新增，无预设菜单，只保留一个「通用」兜底；每个画像含硬规则、词汇表、软习惯、删除倾向、待确认、负样本、适配边界九个维度。 ② 录入校准：走「我出稿、你改稿、脚本算差异、提炼规则、回写画像」的循环；规则须在两个以上独立位置出现并写明轮次依据才算硬规则，手改稿里的错别字隔离为负样本；用字符级留存度区分「换措辞」与「推翻内容」，方向错了就重采基准样本；连续两轮改动低于百分之二十判定收敛，「可以了」视为零信号需再补一次偏离探针；第四轮换题材盲测防过拟合。 ③ 写作代笔：从注册表自动推断场景并一句话确认，按画像写完过五关自检。④ 降级与让路：目标场景没录就退到通用并明确告知；研究报告、财报排雷、小红书文案等内容一律交给对应 skill，本 skill 只做最后一层换语气。

skills.name: prd-to-prototype
skills.description:
prd-to-prototype
Pain Points: Inefficient requirement communication, slow PRD drafting, high prototype review rework.

Goal: Transform vague requirements into professional PRD and interactive prototypes.

Process:

Requirement Clarification: Scenario diagnosis + probing + MRC gate → confirmation table (Excel). Methods: 5W2H, 5 Whys, JTBD, Kano, MoSCoW.
PRD Generation: 13-element structured PRD (MD+Word) with Page Map, features, acceptance criteria, system integration, non-functional requirements. Methods: User Story, Given-When-Then, BPMN, Use Case Diagram.
Prototype Generation: Interactive prototype (HTML) with multi-state display, PRD alignment check, walkthrough script, mobile+PC. Methods: High-fidelity prototype, Information Architecture, Component Library, Heuristic Checklist.
Usage: Trigger Skill, describe requirement (text/image). More specific = fewer rounds. Confirm at each checkpoint before proceeding.
skills.description_zh:
需求PRD到产品原型 prd-to-prototype
解决痛点：需求沟通与PRD梳理低效，产品原型评审返工率高

能力目标：模糊需求生成专业PRD与可交互原型：输入需求 → 场景诊断 → 追问澄清 → 需求确认 → 生成PRD → 可交互原型

处理流程：
1、需求澄清：
场景诊断评估成熟度，多轮追问澄清缺口，MRC门禁保障完整度，输出需求确认表（Excel）。核心方法：5W2H、5Whys、JTBD、Kano、MoSCoW等
2、生成PRD：
基于确认表生成13要素结构化PRD（MD+Word），含Page Map页面清单、功能清单、验收标准、系统集成、非功能性需求等。核心方法：用户故事、Given-When-Then、BPMN、用例图等
3、生成原型：
基于PRD生成可交互原型（HTML），浏览器直接运行，含多状态展示、PRD对齐校验、走查脚本，移动端和PC端。核心方法：高保真原型、信息架构图、组件库保、 走查清单等

使用建议：
触发词启动SKill后，直接描述需求（文字/文档/图片），越具体追问越少。关键节点（需求确认表、PRD文档、产品原型）确认对齐后再执行，减少返工。

(2) The score is a weighted view of measured dimensions whose weights are printed with the output, never a black box. (3) Protected attributes are never scored, and no degree, certificate or project experience is invented; missing input stays marked as missing. The script performs structural checks only; semantic judgement stays with the human.

skills.description_zh:

  SciencePal 同时面向科研机构、医院、企业与高校：既可作为科研人员全天候的研究助手，把数天的前期调研压缩到数小时；也可作为研究培训与 协作底座，帮助学生与青年学者在可见、可评、可复用的流程中学习规范研究方法。无论是新材料研发、生物医学发现，还是教育科研，SciencePal 都致力于让科学探索更快、更透明、更可信。

skills.name: scientific-writing
skills.description: Scientific manuscript citation auditor. Given a manuscript body and its BibTeX bibliography, this skill produces a reviewable red-flag report. It parses BibTeX treating single-line and multi-line entries alike, validates required fields per entry type, and extracts in-text cite keys (typst @key, LaTeX \cite, Pandoc [@key]) to reconcile both directions, reporting dangling citations, uncited entries, duplicate cite keys and malformed entries. Magnitude failures (too few references, or a paper citing only one key) are raised as explicit THIN_COVERAGE and SINGLE_SOURCE red flags instead of being passed by an "at least one valid BibTeX entry" rule. Pure standard library, offline, never writes prose for you.
skills.description_zh: 科学论文写作审计。输入 manuscript 正文与 BibTeX 参考目录，输出可复核的引用完整性报告。解析 BibTeX 时单行与多行条目同等对待，并按条目类型校验必需字段；提取正文 citekey（typst @key、LaTeX \cite、Pandoc [@key]）后做双向对账，报告悬空引用、未引用条目、重复 citekey 与格式坏条目。量级上不满足下限（参考文献过少、整篇只引用一个 key）时显式标 THIN_COVERAGE 与 SINGLE_SOURCE，而不是像上游那样以「至少提取到一条有效 BibTeX」放行整篇。纯标准库，离线可跑，不替你写正文。

skills.name: session-continuity
skills.description:
Long tasks go dumb inside one session (context rot) and lose memory across sessions. This skill provides
a "closeout / continue" session-continuity mechanism: closeout compresses progress into a handoff doc
(5-section briefing + handoff file + daily log + memory update); continue relays state to the next session.
The logic layer is architecture-agnostic; the medium layer uses WorkBuddy as an example and is editable.
Trigger words (closeout / continue) are customizable.
skills.description_zh: 一个 session 聊太长会变蠢？遇到大活一个session干不完怎么办？长任务接力让你把长任务切成一段段干净的对话来做：每次收工留下清楚的交接单（做了啥、定了啥、下一步干啥），下次开工照着接上就能干，不用从头讲、不丢上下文、不重来。用它就把它切成几段，每段都清爽。

skills.name: smart-charts
skills.description: Turn a data file (CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON) into standalone interactive ECharts HTML charts - 32 chart types, 3 themes, fully offline with no CDN. A data profile (--profile: per-column dtype, cardinality, missingness, samples, statistics, entity grain, candidate insight signals, suspected non-data rows) lets the agent read the data itself and decide what to plot when the user has no stated intent - the agent decides which column is an ID, a dimension, or a measure, and which chart to draw, from the profile's objective facts; each chart ships with an embedded fact sheet (plot_stats plus data_preview) whose numbers are the only values an agent may quote in its caption. This skill produces charts and facts, not written reports or narrative documents. TRIGGER: user supplies or points to a tabular data file and wants a chart; asks to 画图/出图/可视化/生成图表/generate a chart/make a graph; wants a table rendered as an interactive HTML chart.

skills.name: smart-disk-cleaner
skills.description: A safe disk-cleanup specialist for Windows / macOS / Linux, built around a performance-headroom gate. It computes headroom from memory/CPU/disk and cleans only when headroom suffices; headroom is re-sampled during scan and execution, throttling on downgrade and aborting below threshold, so cleanup never freezes the PC. It scans read-only and discloses a four-element profile per candidate (what it is / what it does / risk of deleting / impact of keeping) for item-by-item confirmation, executes in risk-graded batches, and moves files to the Recycle Bin, never hard-deleting. Decisions persist into a rule library so identical items need no re-asking. Users may enable a 3-day auto cleanup: low-risk caches are cleaned unattended, medium/high-risk items are only listed for confirmation, keeping a 7-day recoverable window. Use when the user mentions C drive cleanup, disk cleanup, low disk space, clearing cache or junk, slow PC, PC freezing during cleanup, automatic or scheduled cleanup.
skills.description_zh: 磁盘空间清理专家（Windows / macOS / Linux）。核心是性能冗余门禁下的安全清理：先评估本机 CPU/内存/磁盘并计算冗余度，只有冗余足够才允许开始，扫描与执行全程动态复查、掉档自动降速、余量不足立即中止，避免清理过程把用户电脑拖到卡死；再做纯只读扫描，对每个候选项目输出「是什么 / 有什么用 / 删除的风险 / 不删的影响」四要素明细供用户逐项确认；按低-中-高风险分级分批执行，文件只进回收站不硬删除，每批结束清空回收站真正释放空间；完成后输出结算单并把用户决策沉淀为规则库，下次同规则项自动执行不再询问。用户可一次性启用「每 3 天自动清理」：此后低风险缓存自动清、中高风险项只列清单等确认，并保留 7 天可恢复窗口。当用户提到 C盘清理、磁盘清理、空间不足、释放磁盘空间、清理缓存、清理垃圾、电脑变卡、清理时电脑卡死、自动清理、定时清理、disk cleanup、free disk space、storage full、clean my pc 等意图时使用。

skills.name: smart-memory-agent
skills.description: Use when the user says remember this / from now on always / what do you remember about me / the thing we discussed last time, or when the assistant realizes it has forgotten a preference or a decision from an earlier session. Turns agent memory into four runnable actions — capture (write to memory files), recall (answer with provenance), distill (extract rules from daily logs with an evidence chain), audit (health report) — plus a memory ledger that quantifies what was remembered, how many repeated explanations were avoided, and how many contradictions were found and resolved.

skills.name: tdx-macro-transmission
skills.description: TDX Macro Transmission Map: Conducts top-down macro → industry → stock transmission research. It distills the core change of a macro variable, decomposes the multi-stage transmission path (with explicit intermediate variables, no leaps), and distinguishes first-order direct beneficiaries from second-order indirect beneficiaries. Stocks are mapped into four tiers — core-logic names / large-cap anchors / high-beta small-caps / weak-mapping plays — with transmission lags and verification indicators flagged, plus investment implications and risk counter-evidence. It outputs a professional dark-themed HTML research report, draws all data from Tongdaxin MCP, and never provides specific buy/sell timing. |

skills.name: tdx-premarket-navigator
skills.description: TDX premarket-navigator (Pre-Market Navigator): A tool that generates a Chinese pre-market daily report before A-share open. skills.name: tdx-risk-radar
skills.description: TDX Risk Radar: A Tongdaxin-MCP-powered industry risk-shock analysis skill. From five dimensions — macro, policy, geopolitics, industry-cycle, and event-driven — it quantitatively assesses the short-term (0–3 months) and medium-term (3–12 months) shock of various risks on a specified industry, weighted at 20% / 25% / 15% / 25% / 15%. It outputs a structured Markdown report with executive summary, composite scores, per-dimension analysis, and an impact timeline, plus an interactive HTML dashboard with radar chart and risk scorecards. Triggers: industry risk analysis, industry-shock assessment, macro / policy / geopolitical / cycle / event-driven risk scans, etc.

skills.name: teaching-design-studio
skills.description: Instructional design and lesson-plan authoring, plus evidence-based diagnosis of existing teaching designs. Primary to higher education. Not for test generation, PPT styling or grade statistics; for engineering competition materials use teaching-design-craft.
skills.description_zh: 结构化教学设计与教案撰写，以及对已有教学设计的证据化诊断与优化。触发词：写教案、做教学设计、备课、说课设计、公开课设计、单元整体设计、诊断教案、教学设计体检、对标精品课、对标课标、布鲁姆目标层次、目标—教学—评价一致性、改教案。能力：① 从零产出含教学目标（ABCD 法 + 布鲁姆层次）、重难点、教学方法、时间轴教学过程、师生活动与提问链、学习支架、评价量规、分层作业、预习拓展的完整方案，参数缺失时按默认假设（45 分钟、学情中等、常规多媒体教室）补齐并声明；② 五维体检（课标对标、精品课规格、AI 应用、教学技能、五育呈现）加十项量规证据化评分，输出诊断报告与 P0/P1/P2 优先级、落到环节与分钟的优化建议，可出带痕迹的修订稿；③ 布鲁姆层次与三向一致性分析。覆盖中小学至高校各学科。不适用：出题组卷、PPT 美化、成绩统计、视频剪辑；工科教创赛材料与四维实践考核量表改用 teaching-design-craft。

skills.name: teaching-plan-generator
skills.description:
A university-agnostic lesson plan generator for Chinese higher vocational colleges, covering higher vocational, vocational undergraduate, and applied undergraduate levels.

Template-adaptive: when the user supplies their own lesson-plan template, the skill parses its table structure, field labels, and formatting, then treats that template as the sole authoritative baseline. Without a template, it falls back to a built-in generic 6-table structure.

Triggers on requests to generate, draft, or revise lesson plans, plus batch generation and legacy-plan diagnosis.

Ships a template-structure inspector and a docx-filling engine driven by a field-mapping file, with dry-run validation and batch output.

Safeguards: verbatim field labels, mandatory dry-run, and explicit labeling of generic-fallback content.

skills.name: teaching-ppt-generator
skills.description:
A teaching slide (PPT) generator for Chinese higher vocational colleges that turns lesson plans, ability maps, and course standards into classroom-ready 16:9 PPTX files by orchestrating the ppt-master workflow.

Input-adaptive: lesson plans may come from any institution's format (no fixed template assumed); ability maps are parsed dynamically from the HTML treeData; the course accent color is derived from the course name.

Ships an eight-point design confirmation, per-page SVG generation, speaker-note splitting, animation grouping, and a quality checklist, supporting both single-lesson trials and batch generation.

Blends interactive teaching (hooks, polls, discussion), AI-empowered pages, subtle ideological grounding without showing the literal term, and an ability-map page whose domain grid adapts to the actual number of domains.

skills.name: text-data-extraction

skills.description_en: Automatically identify and extract core retail metrics disclosed in the narrative text of joint-stock banks' financial reports, including: (A) AUM, (B) customer count, (C) wealth-management income, (D) credit-card operations, (E) other quantitative metrics, plus (F) segment-profitability metrics (retail revenue/profit/non-interest income/impairment—must be supplemented when Skill 1 fails to extract them from tables) and (G) volume-and-price metrics (deposit cost rate/loan yield/NPL ratio, etc.). skills.name: windows-cleanup
skills.description: Windows Safe Cleanup in a six-stage loop. It measures real disk usage with hard-link aware sampling, runs a read-only audit, produces a tiered cleanup plan, issues a one-time authorization token, executes in stages, then verifies every change and renders a self-contained offline HTML report. A red-line whitelist protects drivers, security software, Windows Update, hardware-essential components and work applications, so they are never touched. All file deletions go through a single safety gateway where permanent deletion is permanently disabled, and every registry change is backed up first and stays reversible. It also classifies system hotspots such as WinSxS and WindowsApps, which are handled only through DISM and Appx tooling with measured size and safe-reclaimable ceiling reported separately, and recognises AI tool caches by ownership directory instead of file extension, tiered by rebuild cost. Windows only, fully local, no network calls and nothing is uploaded.

它是一个专门用于创建、重构、评估和打包 Agent Skill 的元技能。简单来说，它是一个“造技能的技能”。如果你想创建一个新技能、改进已有技能、或者把某个重复流程标准化成 Skill，告诉我你在做什么，它能帮你把工作固化成可复用的知识资产。
使用示例
新建 Skill：从工作流、提示词、对话记录、文档或笔记中，提炼出可复用的 Skill 包
重构 Skill：对已有 Skill 进行优化：精简冗余、厘清边界、改善路由描述
评估 Skill：评测 Skill 的质量（路由准确性、提示工程、产物设计、系统模型）
打包 Skill：输出标准化的 Skill 目录结构，含 SKILL.md、agents/interface.yaml、参考资料等格式。
skills.description_en: Create, refactor, evaluate, and package agent skills from workflows, prompts, transcripts, docs, or notes. Use when asked to create a skill, turn a repeated process into a reusable skill, improve an existing skill, add evals, or package a skill for team reuse.
